stem: During the late 1960s, Mexican American students in Los Angeles participated in the Chicano movement by organizing school walkouts. What was the PRIMARY goal of these walkouts?

options.label: A
options.text: To end the use of poll taxes for voting

options.label: B
options.text: To raise awareness of insufficient educational opportunities

options.label: C
options.text: To protest the rising cost of college education

options.label: D
options.text: To support the passage of a minimum wage law
